data.turoyo: <...> məlle b Aloho magəbli mu zʕurano d kuṯeli. <...>
data.translation: <...> Er sagte: Bei Gott, ich habe Angst vor diesem Jungen bekommen, der mich angreift. <...>

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell: first-person l-series experiencer and overt m- fear stimulus.

summary: III magəbli/magəble has l-series Preterit inflection despite its intransitive experiencer meaning. Fear stimulus uses m- in both supplied passages.
29/219 coordinates qaṭəl zayəʕ with l-series magəble for the same experiencer and stimulus. The shared semantics do not justify transferring gyb to another stem or normalizing its morphology.
JTM 5.2/92 establishes fear of an attacking boy and adds person inflection, not a new sense. No Detransitive or new box is needed.
Does gyb differ from coordinated zayəʕ in intensity, suddenness or avoidance? These two passages do not establish a reliable new distinction.
Confirm whether the l-series inflection is consistent across persons and dialects; no unattested forms inferred.
